# Microsoft SQL Server & T-SQL Performance Architecture

Optimize mission-critical SQL Server relational databases, indexing strategies, and T-SQL stored procedures.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Every table must possess a well-chosen clustered index (preferably unique, narrow, and monotonic).
- Profile query performance using DMVs (`sys.dm_exec_query_stats`, `sys.dm_os_wait_stats`).
- Parameterize all dynamic SQL executions with `sp_executesql` to prevent plan cache bloat and SQL injection.
- Configure appropriate deadlock priority and handle error 1205 gracefully in application code.
